_about: Numbers a change must not fall below, checked by `make gate` (mojo/py/vinci_eval/gate.py). Every number has a from note saying where it was measured. They are floors, not targets: raise one when a measured change is kept. The gate runs on the machine that holds ~/.vinci/eval and ~/.vinci/staging; elsewhere every eval stage is SKIP, which fails the gate unless GATE_ALLOW_SKIP=1.
